finalSyntheticDocumentVisibilityClock.method: Synthetic document.hidden getter plus visibilitychange, not physical backgrounding

coldProductionResourceTiming.method: Page-scoped cache disabled before navigation; actual full-page scroll and image.decode; ResourceTiming values exclude transport beyond reported transferSize

budgets.interpretation: Raw source bytes, HTTP bodies, ResourceTiming transfer estimates, CPU geometry buffers, decoded image dimensions and GPU resource counts are different measurements. No claim of total RAM/VRAM below 3 MB.

limitations: Chromium desktop host at actual DPR1.25, not a physical phone/Safari.
DPR3 was simulated via getter; effective1.5 and shared ownership were observed.

Managed tabs did not become document.hidden=true by switching focus; visibility handler/clock proof uses a controlled getter plus real visibilitychange event. Actual offscreen IntersectionObserver pause was observed.
Blob JSON Download was clicked, but harness download list was empty. Copied JSON and schema were inspected; physical downloaded-file persistence was not certified.
Pending-load cleanup scenario invokes actual viewer.dispose manually, not React unmount.
Approved mobile camera crops preserved; no artistic recalibration or pixel-equivalence claim against the static reference photo.
ResourceTiming decodedBodySize measures HTTP decompression, not pixel memory. GPU counts do not measure VRAM bytes.
